subject: Order form: hosting plan - party details & initial redline asks
body_preview: External sent order form and asked for initial redline; internal legal looped in for SOC2/logistics and billing contact.
messages:
From: Diane Morales <diane.morales@clearwave.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 Mar 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form / Hosting plan questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached is our preferred Order Form and a short SOW draft that reflect the hosting tier we discussed (4 reserved GPUs, EU region, 12-month term). A few quick asks from our side before we route to procurement: 

- Can you confirm whether Redwood will accept EU residency for logs and billing?
- We typically need an SLA subsection for incident response within 2 hours — can that be included?
- Please confirm the billing contact and whether there are any minimum seat counts for dedicated pools.

I'm attaching the files: ClearWave_OrderForm_v1.pdf, ClearWave_SOW_draft.docx (see stubs). Procurement is looped on procurement@clearwave.com.

Appreciate a quick read — we hope to have redlines back by end of week.

Best,
Diane Morales
Head of Cloud Partnerships
ClearWave Analytics

Attachments: ClearWave_OrderForm_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 42KB); ClearWave_SOW_draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 78KB)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diane Morales <diane.morales@clearwave.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Mar 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form / Hosting plan questions

Hi Diane — thanks for sending these over and for the good discussion last week. Looping in Kimberly (Legal) and Jonas (Contracts) to handle the redline and residency/SLA questions.

Quick answers we can provide immediately:
- EU residency for logs and billing: possible via our Private deployment option (VPC) or Dedicated EU pools. We'll confirm what evidence we can provide.
- SLA 2-hour incident response: short answer — customer-facing escalation paths exist and we can propose language; need legal to review exact wording and impact to pricing.
- Billing contact & seat minimums: Default dedicated pools require a 3-node minimum for this hardware tier; I'll confirm whether we can make an exception for ClearWave.

Kimberly / Jonas — attached the customer's order form and SOW. Primary asks: confirm whether SLA/incident-response clause is acceptable, advise on residency language (logs/billing), and capture any material redlines that would affect pricing or deployment mode. Also please flag any IP/data residency exhibits that need to be appended.

Next steps proposed: legal sends a marked-up order form back to Diane by Wed EOD so ClearWave can route to procurement. If we need a short call (15–20 min) to align on residency/SLA tradeoffs, propose Thu morning PT.

Thanks — Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Manager, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearWave_OrderForm_v1.pdf (stub), ClearWave_SOW_draft.docx (stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Diane Morales <diane.morales@clearwave.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form / Hosting plan questions

Thanks Laura — quick read below and a few asks for Diane/Procurement. Posting inline comments in the attached redline, but high level: 

1) Residency: We can support EU residency for logs and billing through Dedicated EU pools. Implementation note: that option will require a written exhibit specifying data flow, KMS key residency, and a monthly surcharge (I estimate ~7–10% uplift).

2) SLA/incident response: We don't commit to a 2-hour remediation guarantee in standard MSA; we can add a 2-hour "initial response" milestone for P1 incidents and a PB (performance-based credit) schedule for critical outages. That is a commercial concession, so it should be conditional on the Dedicated commitment and a 12-month minimum.

3) IP / Data: SOW is fine, but need to add an Exhibit D for logging retention and deletion workflow (customer-controlled delete requests).

Action items for ClearWave: 
- Please confirm whether you will sign Dedicated EU residency (we'll draft the exhibit).
- Confirm acceptance of a modest surcharge for dedicated regional capacity.
- Provide your procurement contact name for invoicing (we currently have procurement@clearwave.com but need a billing contact with name and phone).

I'm attaching my marked-up order form (redline stub: ClearWave_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf). Laura / Kimberly, if you want me to soften language or push different credit levels, say so. Diane — if you'd like a quick call to walk the tradeoffs, I'm available Thu 08:30–11:00 PT.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Contracts Counsel
Redwood Inference

Attachments: ClearWave_OrderForm_redline_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 48KB)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Diane Morales <diane.morales@clearwave.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2025 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form / Hosting plan questions

Diane — great to meet you via email. I reviewed Jonas's notes and attached a few redline suggestions focused on residency language and minimal SLA text that preserves our standard indemnity and limits. Key items:
- We'll add Exhibit D for logging retention and a short residency clause that ties to Dedicated EU pools only.
- For the 2-hour initial response, we propose: "Redwood will acknowledge and begin triage within two (2) hours for P1 incidents and will provide status updates every four (4) hours until resolution." I'll avoid guaranteeing time-to-resolution.
- Billing contact: we need a named contact for invoicing and an address for tax documentation. If procurement wants to stay as a mailbox, we still require an invoicing contact on file.

Proposed next steps: I will post a cleaned redline (OrderForm + Exhibit D stub) to Drive and to this thread by EOD. Laura — can you confirm commercial acceptance of the modest surcharge + dedicated 12-month term so I can lock the language? Diane — once you confirm, we'll hand the redline to your procurement.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: OrderForm_Redline_v1.pdf (stub). Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cDOCS
